scope: Identical controlled terminal-wealth arithmetic for1024 candidate portfolios ×1024 sampled native terminal price vectors ×71 assets. Not optimisation, full160000-leaf scoring, a feasibility-tested policy or a forecast sample used in models. Transfers of fixed inputs and CUDA/CPU startup excluded from steady-state rows; output transfer included. CPU settings are threads, GPU settings are batch sizes, not processes. Production process cap remains48. Trials use same double-precision values; every replay is checked against CPU reference.
energy_scope: Gross CPU package plus GPU board energy, including background and idle; no wall socket measurement. Modelled wall multiplier1.7 and emissions200gCO2e/kWh are sensitivity assumptions, not measured electricity or local grid data. No missing counters replaced with zero.
